# REWIND backend API

<!-- Generated by backend/tests/api_examples.py from real TestClient calls. Do not edit by hand: run `$env:REWIND_REGENERATE = "1"; python -m pytest -q` then remove the variable. -->

Scope: there is **no universal rollback**. Undo supports exactly the changes a recovery adapter implements (`backend/adapters.py`): customer status (`update_customer_status`) and credit limits (`update_credit_limit`).

```powershell
$env:REWIND_DEMO_MODE = "1"; Set-Location backend; uvicorn main:app --reload
```

Base URL `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. CORS allows only `FRONTEND_ORIGIN` (default `http://localhost:5173`; read at startup).

## Envelope

Every response, success or error, is:

```json
{"data": <payload or null>, "error": null | {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": ...}}
```

- `error` is `null` **exactly** when the HTTP status is 2xx.
- Some non-2xx responses still carry `data` (the recorded outcome): policy blocks, Undo conflicts, and unverified/failed writes. Show `error.message`, and use `data` for detail.
- Show "verified" only when `verification.verdict == "verified"`.

## Roles

Send `X-Role` and `X-Role-Key` on every write. This is a demo role gate, **not** an authentication system: keys are shared strings from `REWIND_ROLE_KEYS` (`operator=...,approver=...,auditor=...`), defaulting to the public demo keys `demo-operator-key`, `demo-approver-key`, `demo-auditor-key`.

| Role | May call |
|---|---|
| (none) | `GET /api/customers`, `GET /api/credit-lines`, `GET /api/actions`, `GET /api/actions/{action_id}`, `GET /api/metrics` |
| `operator` | `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status`, `POST /api/tools/update-credit-limit`, `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo`, `POST /api/demo/reset`, `POST /api/agent/runs` |
| `approver` | `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/approve`, `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/reject` |
| `auditor` | `GET /api/audit/export` |

Each write route allows exactly one role. Missing/bad headers → 401 (`role_required`, `invalid_role_key`); a valid role on the wrong route → 403 `role_forbidden`. Nothing is written in either case.

## Credit-limit policy (`backend/policies.yaml`)

Read on every request. If the file is missing, invalid YAML, or has the wrong keys, **every** credit-limit change is blocked with `rule_id: policy_config_invalid` (fails closed). Rules, in order:

| `rule_id` | Outcome | When |
|---|---|---|
| `policy_config_invalid` | 403 blocked | policies.yaml cannot be loaded |
| `protected_customer` | 403 blocked | the owning customer is protected and `block_protected_customers` |
| `no_change` | 409 blocked | new limit equals the current limit |
| `limit_out_of_range` | 403 blocked | outside `min_limit`..`max_limit` |
| `approval_threshold` | 202 pending | new limit above `approval_above` |
| `large_increase` | 202 pending | increase above `approval_increase_pct` % of the current limit |
| `default_allow` | 200 executed | otherwise |

## Approvals

- A change that needs approval (`rule_id: bulk_change`) returns 202 with `status: "pending_approval"` and does **not** touch the customer.
- `approve` re-runs the recorded request through the gateway. It executes only if the customer is exactly as it was when approval was requested (else 409 `approval_stale`) and no blocking rule applies (an approval never overrides a block). The pending row itself becomes `executed` with `approval: {decision, role, at, note}`, and is then undoable as usual.
- `reject` sets `status: "denied"`; the customer is unchanged.
- A request is resolved once; later approve/reject calls → 409 `not_pending`.

## PII

- Customers have `name` and `phone` (synthetic). `GET /api/customers` is the FinCore UI and is unmasked.
- Masked: everything the agent reads through its tools, free-text ledger args (`arguments.reason`) and approval notes, and the whole audit export (`name` → `M*** I***`, phone → only the last 2 digits).
- `before`/`after` snapshots in `GET /api/actions` keep the full row, because Undo and the verifier compare exact rows.

## Refresh advice

- After **any** POST (update, Undo, reset), refetch `GET /api/customers` and `GET /api/actions`. Responses are not pushed; there is no websocket.
- Never compute Undo eligibility in the UI: use `undo_available` / `undo_disabled_reason` from the latest `GET /api/actions`. They are evaluated against the current customer row on every read.
- Polling is optional; if you poll, every 2–5 s is plenty for the demo.

## When Undo is enabled

| Situation | `undo_available` | `undo_disabled_reason` |
|---|---|---|
| Executed status change, customer unchanged since | `true` | `null` |
| Executed, Undo failed before (`recovery_state: restore_failed`) | `true` | `null` |
| Already undone (`recovery_state: recovered`) | `false` | Already undone |
| Customer edited since (version or any field differs) | `false` | Customer changed since this action; Undo would overwrite a newer edit |
| Action was `blocked` / `rejected` / `pending_approval` / `failed` | `false` | Action was blocked; there is no change to undo |
| The row is itself an Undo record | `false` | This is an Undo record; undoing an Undo is not supported |

## Status codes (from the examples below)

| Route | Status | `error.code` | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/demo/reset` | 200 | — | Reset the demo |
| `GET /api/customers` | 200 | — | List customers |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 200 | — | Archive an inactive customer |
| `GET /api/actions/{action_id}` | 200 | — | Get one action (Undo available) |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 200 | — | Undo it |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 200 | — | Undo it again (idempotent) |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 403 | `policy_blocked` | Blocked: protected customer |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 403 | `policy_blocked` | Blocked: recently active |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 409 | `policy_blocked` | Blocked: already has that status |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 409 | `version_conflict` | Stale expected_version |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 404 | `customer_not_found` | Unknown account |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 422 | `invalid_arguments` | Malformed arguments |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 200 | — | Archive another customer |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 200 | — | Someone else edits that customer |
| `GET /api/actions/{action_id}` | 200 | — | Get the earlier action (Undo now disabled) |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 409 | `undo_conflict` | Undo after a newer edit: conflict |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 409 | `not_undoable` | Undo a blocked action |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 404 | `action_not_found` | Undo an unknown action |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 202 | — | Bulk run over threshold (threshold set to 1) |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/approve` | 200 | — | Approve a pending action |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/approve` | 409 | `not_pending` | Approve it again |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 202 | — | Another bulk change waits for approval |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/reject` | 200 | — | Reject a pending action |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 401 | `role_required` | No role headers |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 403 | `role_forbidden` | Wrong role for the route |
| `GET /api/audit/export` | 200 | — | Export the audit trail |
| `GET /api/audit/export` | 403 | `role_forbidden` | Export as an operator |
| `GET /api/credit-lines` | 200 | — | List credit lines |
| `POST /api/tools/update-credit-limit` | 200 | — | Raise a credit limit |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 200 | — | Undo the credit-limit change |
| `POST /api/tools/update-credit-limit` | 403 | `policy_blocked` | Blocked: above max_limit |
| `POST /api/tools/update-credit-limit` | 202 | — | Large increase waits for approval |
| `POST /api/tools/update-credit-limit` | 404 | `credit_line_not_found` | No credit line for the account |
| `GET /api/actions` | 200 | — | List actions |
| `GET /api/metrics` | 200 | — | Metrics (no saved lab run) |
| `POST /api/agent/runs` | 501 | `not_implemented` | Reserved: start an agent run |
| `GET /api/runs/run-1/evidence` | 501 | `not_implemented` | Reserved: run evidence |
| `GET /api/nope` | 404 | `route_not_found` | Unknown route |
| `POST /api/demo/reset` | 403 | `demo_mode_off` | Reset with demo mode off |

## Configuration (env vars)

| Var | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `REWIND_DB_PATH` | `backend/data/rewind.db` | SQLite file |
| `REWIND_DEMO_MODE` | off | `1` enables reset and the fixed demo clock (2026-10-22T12:00:00Z) |
| `FRONTEND_ORIGIN` | `http://localhost:5173` | The only origin allowed by CORS |
| `REWIND_RECENT_ACTIVITY_DAYS` | `90` | Archiving a customer active within N days is blocked |
| `REWIND_BULK_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD` | `3` | Executed changes per `run_id` before approval is required |
| `REWIND_FAULT_DISABLE_RECENT_ACTIVITY` | off | Injected fault (demo mode only): disables only `recent_activity`; affected actions carry `scenario: "injected_fault"` |

### `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status`

Body: `account_id`, `new_status`, `reason` (required, 1–500 chars), optional `expected_version`, optional `run_id`. Unknown keys are rejected.

#### Archive an inactive customer

```http
POST /api/tools/update-customer-status
X-Role: operator
X-Role-Key: demo-operator-key
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "account_id": "ACC-102",
  "new_status": "Archived",
  "reason": "Inactive for 591 days",
  "expected_version": 1,
  "run_id": "run-1"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "action_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    "decision": "allow",
    "rule_id": "default_allow",
    "reason": null,
    "risk": "medium",
    "scenario": null,
    "before": {
      "account_id": "ACC-102",
      "name": "Meera Iyer",
      "phone": "+91 90000 00102",
      "status": "Active",
      "last_activity_at": "2025-03-10T12:00:00Z",
      "protected": false,
      "version": 1
    },
    "status": "executed",
    "recovery_state": "available",
    "after": {
      "account_id": "ACC-102",
      "name": "Meera Iyer",
      "phone": "+91 90000 00102",
      "status": "Archived",
      "last_activity_at": "2025-03-10T12:00:00Z",
      "protected": false,

    },
    "verification": {
      "verdict": "verified",
      "stage": "pre_commit_guard",

        },
        {
          "id": "version_incremented_by_one",
          "description": "Target row's version, re-read inside the same transaction",
          "expected": 2,
          "actual": 2,
          "passed": true
        },
        {
          "id": "other_customers_unchanged_in_transaction",
          "description": "Count and SHA-256 of all other rows in customers table, before vs after the UPDATE, inside the same transaction",
          "expected": {
            "row_count": 7,

}
```

#### Bulk run over threshold (threshold set to 1)

Setup: one change already executed in `run-bulk`, with `REWIND_BULK_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD=1`. No customer change is made; no approval UI exists yet.

```http
POST /api/tools/update-customer-status
X-Role: operator
X-Role-Key: demo-operator-key
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "account_id": "ACC-102",
  "new_status": "Archived",
  "reason": "Inactive for 591 days",
  "run_id": "run-bulk"
}
```

Response `202`:

```json

    "risk": "medium",

    "before": {

      "status": "Active",
```

### `POST /api/tools/update-credit-limit` (operator)

Body: `account_id`, `new_limit` (whole INR, 0..1,000,000,000), `reason` (required), optional `expected_version`, optional `run_id`. Approve, reject and Undo work exactly as for status changes; Undo evidence uses `current_credit_line` / `other_credit_lines`.

#### Raise a credit limit

```http
POST /api/tools/update-credit-limit
X-Role: operator
X-Role-Key: demo-operator-key
Content-Type: application/json

  "new_limit": 100000,
  "reason": "Six months of on-time payments"
}
```

### `GET /api/metrics`

Measured from the ledger and the last saved lab run (`python backend/lab.py` writes `backend/data/lab_last_run.json`). Values that cannot be measured are `null`. `assumptions` lists every definition used; read it before quoting a number. `false_verified.count` must be 0.

#### Metrics (no saved lab run)

Timings in this example come from the docs' fixed clock (one second per ledger write), not from real elapsed time.

```http
GET /api/metrics
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "measured_at": "2026-10-22T12:00:26+00:00",
    "actions": {
      "total": 14,
      "executed": 6,
      "blocked": 4,
      "flagged": 3,
      "by_status": {
        "blocked": 4,
        "denied": 1,
        "executed": 6,
        "pending_approval": 1,
        "rejected": 2
      }
    },
    "recoveries": {
      "total": 3,
      "verified": 2,
      "conflict_detected": 1,
      "failed": 0,
      "manual_review_required": 0,
      "unverified": 0
    },
    "time_to_verified_recovery_seconds": {
      "samples": 2,
      "median": 2.0,
      "max": 2.0,
      "excluded_no_timestamp": 0
    },
    "false_verified": {
      "count": 0,
      "ledger": 0,
      "lab": null
    },
    "lab": {
      "available": false,
      "path": "no-lab-run-saved\\lab_last_run.json"
    },
    "assumptions": [
      "actions.* counts forward actions only (every ledger row whose tool is not 'undo'); actions.by_status has the full breakdown.",
      "actions.executed = status 'executed' (includes approved-then-executed); actions.blocked = status 'blocked' (policy blocks).",
      "actions.flagged = forward actions for which at least one Undo was requested. The ledger has no separate 'flag' event, so requesting Undo is treated as flagging the action as wrong. Flagged overlaps executed.",
      "recoveries.* counts every Undo attempt row by its stored post-commit verdict; 'unverified' means no verdict was stored.",
      "time_to_verified_recovery: from the first Undo attempt on an action (its ledger created_at) to verification.checked_at of the attempt whose stored verdict is 'verified'. Recoveries without a stored checked_at (older rows) are counted in excluded_no_timestamp, not estimated.",
      "false_verified.ledger = Undo rows whose stored verdict is 'verified' but whose own evidence does not support it (a required check missing, any check not passed, expected != actual, or stage not post_commit). It checks the stored evidence; it does not re-read current data.",
      "false_verified.lab = scenarios in the last saved lab run whose actual outcome says 'verified' when the expected outcome does not. null when no lab run is saved.",
      "false_verified.count = ledger + lab (lab counted only when a lab run is saved). It must be 0.",
      "lab.* comes from the file the lab CLI writes (python backend/lab.py), not from this database."
    ]
  },
  "error": null
}
```

## Changes since the last version (credit-limit adapter)

- New route `GET /api/metrics` (open read).
- Post-commit `verification` objects (Undo) gain `checked_at`: when the verdict was reached.
- The lab CLI saves its last run for `/api/metrics`.
